sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_GRDT_YHKB A USING ( SELECT #GR_NO# AS GR_NO , #GR_SEQUENC# AS GR_SEQUENC FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1 = 1 AND A.GR_NO = B.GR_NO AND A.GR_SEQUENC = B.GR_SEQUENC ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TYPE , STATUS , COMPANY_CO , YEAR , GR_NO , GR_SEQUENC , PO_NO , PO_LINE , ITEM_CODE , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , GR_QUANTITY , UOM , UNIT_PRICE , CURRENCY , RECEIVING_AMOUNT , GR_DATE , PLANT_CODE , BUSINESS_AREA , COST_CENTER , ORIGINAL_GR_NO , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE ) VALUES ( NVL(TRIM(#TYPE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#STATUS#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#COMPANY_CO#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#YEAR#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#GR_NO#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#GR_SEQUENC#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#PO_NO#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#PO_LINE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#ITEM_CODE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#DESCRIPTION#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#SPECIFICATION#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#GR_QUANTITY#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#UOM#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#UNIT_PRICE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#CURRENCY#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#RECEIVING_AMOUNT#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#GR_DATE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#PLANT_CODE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#BUSINESS_AREA#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#COST_CENTER#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#ORIGINAL_GR_NO#), ' '), 'N', SYSDATE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TYPE = #TYPE# , STATUS = #STATUS# , COMPANY_CO = #COMPANY_CO# , YEAR = #YEAR# , PO_NO = #PO_NO# , PO_LINE = #PO_LINE# , ITEM_CODE = #ITEM_CODE# , DESCRIPTION = #DESCRIPTION# , SPECIFICATION = #SPECIFICATION# , GR_QUANTITY = #GR_QUANTITY# , UOM = #UOM# , UNIT_PRICE = #UNIT_PRICE# , CURRENCY= #CURRENCY# , RECEIVING_AMOUNT = #RECEIVING_AMOUNT# , GR_DATE = #GR_DATE# , PLANT_CODE = #PLANT_CODE# , BUSINESS_AREA = #BUSINESS_AREA# , COST_CENTER = #COST_CENTER# , ORIGINAL_GR_NO = #ORIGINAL_GR_NO# , IF_FLAG = 'N' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE
